title: 日本ダービーの後に・一難去って…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanefukukitaru makes a brilliant showing at the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She breathes a sigh of relief, thinking her next race will not be as difficult, but…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fate decides her next challenge will be the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The thought of another large-scale challenge has Matikanefukukitaru shrieking with dismay.
